title: Block Cascade
subtitle: Dynamic grid-based puzzle game with connected-block matching and chain reactions
challenge: Implement a responsive grid-based puzzle system where blocks fall and refill dynamically. The core challenge was efficiently detecting connected blocks of the same color using a flood-fill algorithm and managing asynchronous state during block collection, removal, and chain reactions.
architecture: Singleton pattern for GameManager and GridManager; event-driven block interactions with flood-fill algorithm for connected-component detection; coroutine-based state management for animation timing and grid refill sequences.
